topic: Interior Lighting Sub System (SSTS) signal specifications for Z-ONE-3.0 platform
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific signal interface used for communication between the Light Head Control Unit (LHZCU) and various lamp modules (e.g., FtwlAmbtLamp_FL, FtwlAmbtLamp_FR) within the Interior Lighting Sub System.

column_semantics.Direction: Indicates whether the signal is an input or output.
column_semantics.Type: Communication protocol type (e.g., CAN/LIN/SOA service/hardware line).
column_semantics.Sender/Provider: The entity that sends or provides the signal.
column_semantics.Receiver/Consumer: The entity that receives or consumes the signal.
column_semantics.Channel: Specific communication channel used for the signal.

core_entities.name: LHZCU
core_entities.description: Light Head Control Unit, responsible for controlling various lighting functions.

core_conditions.name: AmbtLghtLHRolliingCtr_1
core_conditions.description: Ambient light rolling control signal, used for continuous dimming or breathing effects.

core_conditions.name: FtwlFLlampOnOff_1
core_conditions.description: Front left ambient lamp on/off request signal.

core_conditions.name: FtwlFLlampColorCmd_1
core_conditions.description: Front left ambient lamp color command signal.

core_conditions.name: FtwlFLlampBrtnsCmd_1
core_conditions.description: Front left ambient lamp brightness command signal.

core_conditions.name: FtwlFLlampBrthngCmd_1
core_conditions.description: Front left ambient lamp breathing command signal.

core_outputs.name: AmbtLghtLHRolliingCtr_1
core_outputs.description: Output signal for ambient light rolling control.

core_outputs.name: FtwlFLlampOnOff_1
core_outputs.description: Output signal for ambient light on/off control.

core_outputs.name: FtwlFLlampColorCmd_1
core_outputs.description: Output signal for ambient light color selection.

core_outputs.name: FtwlFLlampBrtnsCmd_1
core_outputs.description: Output signal for ambient light brightness adjustment.

core_outputs.name: FtwlFLlampBrthngCmd_1
core_outputs.description: Output signal for ambient light breathing effect control.

core_timing_constraints.name: AmbtLghtLHRolliingCtr_1
core_timing_constraints.description: Signal value range: 0-255; can be used for LIN heartbeat; stops breathing when not updated.

core_timing_constraints.name: FtwlFLlampColorCmd_1
core_timing_constraints.description: Value 0x00 = No Request; Values 0x01-0xFF = Various color values.

core_timing_constraints.name: FtwlFLlampBrtnsCmd_1
core_timing_constraints.description: Value 0x00 = No Request; Values 0x00-0x64 = Brightness percentage; Values 0x65-0xFF = Reserved.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the signal interfaces and their characteristics for controlling interior ambient lighting functions in the Z-ONE-3.0 platform's SSTS. It specifies how the LHZCU communicates with different lamp modules to control features such as on/off, color, brightness, and breathing effects.
